desc: Ideation: reduce to labeled selection and choose WQS/Aliens trick; correct penalty to per-pair with doubled values to handle half-integer slopes.
Implement fast input and per-case storage of doubled coordinates, max doubled value, and M=2K.

Implement calc(p) as an unrolled 8-state max-plus DP with encoded lexicographic state ((doubled adjusted value) << 17 + count), using per-item penalty p on doubled values and a safe negative sentinel.
Binary search largest p in [0, max_doubled+1] with returned count >= M, then compute answer = (val2 + p*M)//2.
Validate on samples and small random cases against an exact O(N*M*8) DP/brute force, and check performance for sum N=1e5.
If WQS is too slow, switch to a top-b local parity-correction algorithm or optimize the DP (e.g., built-in max, tighter loops) as a fallback.
